title: 700 MB asset: full download and SHA-256 verify, OPFS and IndexedDB (Sprint 1 done-when, part 1)

commit.note: No commit hash was recorded. The run was made on the uncommitted Sprint 1 working tree; the first commit of this repository (ccf10b6) was made at 12:22 on 2026-11-09, after the run.

machine.label: Apple M5 Pro 48 GB
machine.browser: Google Chrome 157.0.8103.38, Playwright 1.65.0 channel "chrome", Node v22.22.3

method: big.spec.ts downloads a synthetic 734003200-byte stream (xorshift64*) from the repository range server on 127.0.0.1 into the store, with a 50 ms progress interval. Wall time is Date.now() around ensure(), which downloads, hashes and commits the file, and mbPerSecond is bytes / 1e6 / seconds; peak JS heap is JSHeapUsedSize from the CDP Performance.getMetrics, sampled every 250 ms. The sha256 recorded by the page is compared with the independent digest of node test/tools/asset-digest.mjs big 734003200. run1 is the first run (the figures the README quotes); run2 is a re-run the same day on the same machine and server (the lane report calls it round 2) and is kept to show the run-to-run spread.
commands: RUNTIME_BIG=1 RUNTIME_BIG_OUT=<dir> npx playwright test -c test/browser/playwright.config.ts big.spec.ts
